qa_pair.question: Find the runway at KJFK with surface type CONC that has the longest length in feet. What is the length? Provide only the number.
Compare all runway ends at Los Angeles International (KLAX). Which runway end ID has the highest recorded elevation? Provide just the runway end ID.
At Seattle-Tacoma (KSEA), how many total runway ends exist across all active runways? Provide only the number.
At Chicago O'Hare (KORD), how many runways have a length of 10000 feet or greater? Provide only the number.
Identify the runway at Denver International (KDEN) that has a length of 16000 feet. What is its surface type code? Provide only the code.
Compare all runway ends at San Francisco International (KSFO). Which runway end ID has the highest recorded elevation? Provide only the runway end ID.
Find the runway end at Miami International (KMIA) with the highest true alignment value. Provide only the runway end ID.
Query Boston Logan (KBOS) for its runways. How many runways have a physical width of 150 feet? Provide only the number.
At Newark Liberty International (KEWR), identify the shortest paved airplane runway (excluding helipads). Provide only its runway ID.
Locate runway end 22R at Detroit Metro (KDTW). What is the specified approach light system code? Provide only the code.
What is the ICAO code of Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport? Provide only the code.
How many runways does PANC have? Provide only the number.
What is the FAA identifier of Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport? Provide only the identifier.

A flight near Denver International (KDEN) needs to divert. What is the FAA identifier of the nearest public-use airport, other than KDEN, that has a paved runway of at least 8000 feet with an ILS? Provide only the identifier.
Within 40 nautical miles of San Francisco International (KSFO), which other airport is the closest one with a runway at least 10000 feet long? Provide only its FAA identifier.
How long is the longest runway at airport KZZQ? If the airport does not exist in the FAA data, answer NOT_FOUND.
What is the current weather (METAR) at KJFK? If your tools cannot provide it, answer UNAVAILABLE.
